titleEn: I Will Fix That for You

pages.text: They were flying paper planes in the yard. The children folded paper in half.
"My plane will fly farthest." Gaga peered at each child's paper.
Gaga took Mio's plane and folded it again. The wings became crooked.
Gaga took Lala's plane too. "I will fix that for you."
Gaga's own paper was still on the table, not even halfway folded.
One, two, three! The children threw their planes. They flew straight ahead.
Gaga's plane was unfinished. As soon as Gaga threw it, it dropped at their feet.
Teacher Bau offered fresh paper. "Finish folding your own plane, and it can fly far."
Gaga folded the paper, pressing firmly. The wings became neat and straight.
Gaga threw hard. The plane flew to the end of the yard. The children all ran after it.
